ability.jaycee.thunderbolt.desc: Zeus's lightning strikes where you look.
ability.jaycee.hermes_dash.desc: A burst of speed in the direction you face.
ability.jaycee.shadow_step.desc: Step through shadow to the block you look at.
ability.jaycee.aegis.desc: Athena's shield: absorption hearts for 15 seconds.
jaycee.message.look_at_block: Look at a block within 24 blocks
jaycee.birthright.mortal_born.subtitle: An ordinary soul. Everything must be earned.
jaycee.birthright.mortal_born.chat: You were born Mortal. The Mist hides the hidden world from you, for now.
jaycee.birthright.oracle_born.subtitle: The Mist is thin around you.
jaycee.birthright.oracle_born.chat: You were born Oracle-born. You will see what others cannot, but it cannot touch you yet.
jaycee.birthright.godblood.subtitle: A god's blood runs in your veins.
jaycee.birthright.godblood.chat: You were born Godblood, the distant child of a god. The hidden world sees you, and it can reach you.
jaycee.prayer.answer: The gods answer your prayer: you carry %s Ichor. You are %s.
race.jaycee.human.desc: Adaptable and quick to learn, humans have no great strength or weakness, and can walk any road to power.
race.jaycee.awakened_human.desc: A human whose spirit has stirred; mana answers them more readily than it does other mortals.
race.jaycee.hallowed_human.desc: A human whose soul has hardened against harm; saints and sages are made of this.
race.jaycee.exalted_human.desc: A human who has risen past mortal limits, half body and half spirit.
race.jaycee.divine_human.desc: A human who has reached divinity, ageless and unbreakable in body and soul.
race.jaycee.elf.desc: Long-lived forest folk with deep mana and quick feet, but frailer bodies.
race.jaycee.high_elf.desc: An elf whose bond with mana has deepened; their spells come faster and hit harder.
race.jaycee.elder_elf.desc: An elf who has lived through ages, carrying the forest's old magic.
race.jaycee.starborn_elf.desc: An elf touched by starlight, more spirit than flesh.
race.jaycee.divine_elf.desc: An elf who has reached divinity, a living fount of magic.
race.jaycee.dwarf.desc: Stout mountain folk: tough, strong and slow, with little mana but iron will.
race.jaycee.forgeborn_dwarf.desc: A dwarf tempered like steel in the forge's heat.
race.jaycee.runelord_dwarf.desc: A dwarf who carves power into runes and stone.
race.jaycee.mountain_sovereign.desc: A dwarf whose body has become as unyielding as the mountain itself.
race.jaycee.divine_dwarf.desc: A dwarf who has reached divinity, a smith of the gods.
race.jaycee.beastfolk.desc: Fierce folk with the blood of beasts: fast, strong, and hard to keep down.
race.jaycee.beast_warrior.desc: Beastfolk who has honed instinct into a weapon.
race.jaycee.beast_lord.desc: Beastfolk whom lesser beasts follow without question.
race.jaycee.spirit_beast.desc: Beastfolk whose body has merged with the spirit of the wild.
race.jaycee.divine_beast.desc: Beastfolk who has reached divinity, the wild given a god's form.
race.jaycee.goblin.desc: Small, quick and cunning. Weak alone, but every goblin hopes to become something more.
race.jaycee.hobgoblin.desc: A goblin grown taller and wiser, a leader among its kin.
race.jaycee.goblin_warlord.desc: A goblin who commands warbands and fears no larger race.
race.jaycee.goblin_sovereign.desc: A goblin ruler whose presence alone rallies hordes.
race.jaycee.divine_goblin.desc: A goblin who has reached divinity, proof that the smallest can rise highest.
race.jaycee.orc.desc: Hulking and hungry, orcs shrug off blows that would fell others.
race.jaycee.high_orc.desc: An orc whose hunger has turned to discipline and strength.
race.jaycee.orc_warlord.desc: An orc who leads warhosts and grows stronger with every fallen foe.
race.jaycee.orc_calamity.desc: An orc whose rampage is spoken of like a natural disaster.
race.jaycee.divine_boar.desc: An orc who has reached divinity, the great boar of legend.
race.jaycee.ogre.desc: Huge and brutal, ogres hit harder than any other starting race.
race.jaycee.oni.desc: An ogre refined into a horned warrior with a sharper mind.
race.jaycee.elder_oni.desc: An oni whose strength has become art.
race.jaycee.oni_sovereign.desc: An oni who rules by might, its aura alone a weapon.
race.jaycee.divine_oni.desc: An oni who has reached divinity, a war god given flesh.
race.jaycee.slime.desc: Small, soft and weak in body, but a slime holds more mana than any other starting race.
race.jaycee.greater_slime.desc: A slime grown larger and steadier, its core bright with mana.
race.jaycee.elder_slime.desc: A slime old enough to hold a mind and a will of its own.
race.jaycee.ancient_slime.desc: A slime of uncanny age and power, able to reshape itself at will.
race.jaycee.divine_slime.desc: A slime that has reached divinity, formless and boundless.
race.jaycee.lizardfolk.desc: Scaled warriors of rivers and marshes, tough and strong.
race.jaycee.drakefolk.desc: Lizardfolk with drake blood stirring, scales hard as iron.
race.jaycee.dragonkin.desc: Lizardfolk whose dragon blood has fully woken.
race.jaycee.elder_dragonkin.desc: Dragonkin of great age, nearly a dragon in all but form.
race.jaycee.divine_dragon.desc: Lizardfolk who has reached divinity, a true dragon.
race.jaycee.giant.desc: Towering and immensely strong, giants are slow but nearly impossible to stop.
race.jaycee.hill_giant.desc: A giant grown larger, each step shaking the ground.
race.jaycee.ancient_giant.desc: A giant of the old world, strong enough to move hills.
race.jaycee.titanborn.desc: A giant with the blood of titans, vast in body and aura.
race.jaycee.divine_titan.desc: A giant who has reached divinity: a titan reborn.
race.jaycee.lesser_daemon.desc: A spirit from beyond, given a body. Rich in mana and drawn to the power of the fallen.
race.jaycee.daemon.desc: A daemon that has grown a stronger body and a sharper hunger.
race.jaycee.greater_daemon.desc: A daemon of real power, feared by mortals.
race.jaycee.archdaemon.desc: One of the mightiest daemons, commanding lesser ones.
race.jaycee.daemon_sovereign.desc: A daemon that has reached divinity: a dark god.
race.jaycee.wight.desc: The restless dead, risen again. Undead take in more from what they kill.
race.jaycee.grave_knight.desc: A wight armored in death, steady and unafraid.
race.jaycee.wight_king.desc: A wight that rules over the restless dead.
race.jaycee.lich_lord.desc: An undead sorcerer of terrible power.
race.jaycee.deathless_sovereign.desc: An undead that has reached divinity: death itself made king.
jaycee.race_menu.title: Choose your rebirth
